name: NESCAN Local Environment Action Fund (LEAF)
summary: Small grants for community groups in Aberdeen City for climate and nature projects such as wildflower meadows, wildlife habitats and tree planting. Applicants must be NESCAN members.

amount.note: Up to £3,000 per group or organisation in any financial year

reporting: Send receipts showing what the money was spent on and return a short form on how it was spent and its impact within 6 months of funds being allocated.

steps: Admin check: governance, NESCAN membership, past feedback form

eligibility.rule: Is a not-for-profit community organisation based in Aberdeen City with annual income under £200,000
Has returned the funding feedback form if previously funded by Seed or LEAF
Runs a project located in Aberdeen City
Demonstrates at least one listed environmental outcome
Shows support for one or more listed social outcomes
Not carbon trading or offsetting, fossil-fuel equipment, or environmentally damaging work

applicant_types.quote: Any local not-for-profit community organisation with an annual income under £200,000 can apply for projects to be located in Aberdeen City.

geography.quote: Any local not-for-profit community organisation with an annual income under £200,000 can apply for projects to be located in Aberdeen City.

administered_by.quote: North East Scotland Climate Action Network (NESCAN) Hub on behalf of Aberdeen City Council, is delighted to launch LEAF

access.quote: Simply click the 'Apply now' links in the green buttons to access the application form.

window.quote: We allocate to eligible applications on a first come first served basis.

amount.quote: Yes up to a maximum of £3,000 per group or organisation for any financial year

reporting.quote: We will issue you with a short form to complete to explain how you have spent the money and the impact it has made. Please return this form within 6 months of your funds being allocated.

effort.quote: Apply via the Funding Form on our website.
Our administration will check that you meet the governance requirements and that you are a member of NESCAN.
Your application will not process to our Funding Panel unless or until such form is returned to us.

Your application will be assessed by our Funding Panel, which meets on a rolling basis, and a decision will be made whether your application meets all the criteria and is approved, it is rejected as not meeting the criteria or needs further information/ some adjustments.

eligibility.quote: Any not-for-profit community groups or organisations based in Aberdeen City, with an annual income under £200,000, can apply.
Please note only NESCAN members are eligible to apply for LEAF.

Where an applicant has received Seed or LEAF funding in a previous financial year, the applicant organisation must have completed and returned our funding feedback form before you can apply for funding in a new round.
Funding is for projects located in Aberdeen City only.
Projects must demonstrate how they aim to achieve at least one of the following outcomes:
Applications need to also show how the project will support one or more of the following social outcomes:

We don't fund projects that: 1. Support market-based responses to climate change such as carbon trading or carbon offsetting. 2. Purchase equipment that uses fossil fuel. 3. Involve any environmentally damaging activities.

after_award.quote: You will be expected, as a condition of the Grant, to fill in a Feedback Form within 6ms or when your project is complete, whichever is sooner.
